name: Pennsylvania
summary: The state coat of arms on blue: two black horses supporting a shield with a ship, a plough and three sheaves of wheat, under a bald eagle, with the motto 'Virtue, Liberty and Independence'.
origin: The coat of arms was designed in 1778 by Caleb Lownes. A 1907 law standardised the flag with the arms on a blue field matching the US flag.

colors.name: Blue
colors.meaning: The same blue as the US flag.

symbols.name: Ship
symbols.description: A sailing ship at the top of the shield.

symbols.name: Plough and wheat
symbols.description: A plough and three sheaves of wheat.

symbols.name: Horses
symbols.meaning: Strength; the cornstalk and olive branch beneath them stand for prosperity and peace.

facts: Pennsylvania is one of four US states officially called a Commonwealth.
The Declaration of Independence and Constitution were both signed in Philadelphia.
Its arms appear on the state's licence plates and seal.
clues: Two black horses supporting a shield with a ship, a plough and wheat, under an eagle, on blue.
Its motto is 'Virtue, Liberty and Independence'.
